proposal.hypothesis: The supplied feedback reports complete hard and semantic passes on all six incumbent development tasks, so there is no observed failure to repair. The supplied shared contract already defines task scope, verdicts, evidence, and the distinction between observations and recommendations. Replacing only the opening reviewer sentence with a reference to that contract should preserve complete passes on every development task while reducing trimmed Unicode codepoint count from 393 to 331 (15.78%). Any development regression falsifies this hypothesis; adoption requires the fixed independent checks. This candidate has not been evaluated. Character reduction is only a context-length proxy, not evidence of token savings, cost savings, or general quality improvement.
